context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 40 verified TWO critical bug fixes: (1) Manual (adopted) positions no longer trigger liquidation_stop exit - protective_liq_level is set to 0.0 in _sync_exchange_position (line 1873) and check_exit passes protective_level=0.0 for manual origins (line 728). Manual positions still trigger hard_sl, trailing_exit, tp_cap exits but NOT liquidation_stop or early_exit. (2) exchange_closed closedPnl check now validates timestamps - _filter_recent_closed_pnl method (line 2257-2268) filters records by updatedTime/createdTime with max 5 min age. Old closedPnl records from previous trades no longer count as evidence for exchange_closed finalization. Config changes: exchange_closed_confirm_cycles=5 (was 3), exchange_closed_force_cycles=20 (was 8).

manual_position_no_liquidation_stop.behavior: Manual positions have protective_liq_level=0.0, so ExitEngine.check_exit skips liquidation_stop check (if protective_level > 0 condition fails)

manual_position_no_early_exit.behavior: allow_early_exit=(pos.origin == 'bot') means manual positions skip early_exit check

manual_position_still_triggers_hard_sl.behavior: Manual positions still trigger hard_sl when price hits stop_loss

manual_position_still_triggers_trailing_.behavior: Manual positions still trigger trailing_exit when trailing is active and price hits trailing_stop

manual_position_still_triggers_tp_cap.behavior: Manual positions still trigger tp_cap when price hits take_profit

filter_recent_closed_pnl_method.behavior: Static method filters closedPnl records by timestamp (updatedTime or createdTime), keeping only records from last max_age_sec seconds (default 300 = 5 min)

exchange_closed_uses_recent_closed.behavior: exchange_closed finalization now uses recent_closed (timestamp-filtered) instead of all closedPnl records

exchange_closed_confirm_cycles_5.behavior: 5 cycles required before confirming position closed (was 3)

exchange_closed_force_cycles_20.behavior: 20 cycles required before force-finalizing without closedPnl evidence (was 8)
